name: Lightcrawler Pits
description: The Lightcrawler Pits are a labyrinth of bioluminescent caverns and holy-charged tunnels beneath the Tenebrous Ridge. Lightcrawler swarms hunt here at night, empowered by resonance winds and ancient Luclin holy energy. Akhevan scouts and Vampyric raiders avoid the Pits except during ritual incursions.
